rules.description:
Each time an enemy unit ends a move (the triggering unit must not have AIRCRAFT), during the Movement phase, in the opponent's turn, while the triggering unit is within 8" of a friendly KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit:
  -> Select one friendly KHORNE LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit within 8" of the triggering unit: that unit can make a Surge move of up to D6".
rules.name: Murdercall

rules.description: At the end of each phase, if 1+ enemy units destroyed this phase, while the unit is within range of an objective marker, if you control 1+ objectives, objective markers this model controls remain under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over them is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
rules.name: Blood Tainted

characteristics.$text: When the unit ends a Consolidation move, the triggering unit can Consolidate up to 6".

characteristics.$text: The unit gains the Leader ability.

characteristics.$text: When the unit ends an ingress move, while the unit has the Deep Strike ability, the triggering unit can be set up on the battlefield more than 8" away from all enemy models.
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text:
If your Army Faction is CHAOS DAEMONS, your deployment zone is within The Shadow of Chaos. At the start of each phase, if you control at least half of the objectives in no man's land, no man's land is within The Shadow of Chaos until the end of the phase (evaluated once at that time). At the start of each phase, if you control at least half of the objectives in your opponent's deployment zone, your opponent's deployment zone is within The Shadow of Chaos until the end of the phase (evaluated once at that time).
-> When a friendly unit takes a Battle-shock test (the triggering unit must have LEGIONES DAEMONICA): if your Army Faction is CHAOS DAEMONS, while the triggering unit is within The Shadow of Chaos, the triggering unit gets +1 to Battle-shock rolls; if the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, unless the triggering unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, the triggering unit regains up to D3 lost wounds; if the triggering unit has the BATTLELINE keyword, if the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, return D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to the triggering unit, each with its full wounds remaining.
-> When an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test: if your Army Faction is CHAOS DAEMONS, while the triggering unit is within The Shadow of Chaos or while the triggering unit is within 6" of a friendly unit with the BLOODTHIRSTER, GREAT UNCLEAN ONE, KAIROS FATEWEAVER, KEEPER OF SECRETS, LORD OF CHANGE, ROTIGUS, SHALAXI HELBANE or SKARBRAND keyword, the triggering unit gets -1 to Battle-shock rolls; if the triggering battle shock roll was a failure, the triggering unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
characteristics.name: Description

characteristics.$text:
Each time an enemy unit starts a Fall Back move (the triggering unit must not have MONSTER or VEHICLE), while the triggering unit is a unit within Engagement Range of a friendly unit with the Bane of Cowards ability:
  -> While the triggering unit is Battle-shocked, the triggering unit must take a Desperate Escape test, applying -1 to that test.
  -> While the triggering unit is not Battle-shocked, the triggering unit must take a Desperate Escape test.
